verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no auto-shutdown timer, idle-stop, or configurable spend limit for instances. The billing docs describe prepaid credit and an autobilling feature that tops the account up so instances are not interrupted. That is the opposite of a spend cap. At most it is an adjacent implication that running out of credit can interrupt instances, not a deliberate safeguard.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can set auto-shutdown timers or spend limits so a forgotten instance can't silently run up a huge bill
